title: Ready? Set. Haiya!
description:
Do you have what it takes to be the legendary kung-fu warrior?

Originally designed as an alternate controller experience, we are adjusting the controls for the game so that traditional keyboard users can experience what it feels like to be a kung-fu master!Three unique playable characters
• The Uptown Red L

• The graceful GioGio

• The Initimidating BoBo
Two playable levels/OSTs
• Rhythmic Intensity

• Tight Ship

Each track is a 2-4 minute intense experience, so make sure to be warmed up before you try them out!
description_short: Ready? Set. Haiya! is a fighting-styled rhythm game, where players follow on-screen commands and try to time them as perfectly as they can, to try and beat their opponents to the beat in this epic groovy showdown.
